name: Insanity Wolf
look: A snarling dark gray wolf head with bared fangs, a wide-open mouth and glowing red eyes, cut out and placed over a grainy black, gray and white sunburst background in the classic advice-animal style.
use: An advice-animal macro for insane overreactions. The top line sets up an ordinary situation and the bottom line gives the most unhinged, extreme response possible, written in all caps.
slots: bottom text: the wildly extreme response
examples: Recipe calls for one clove of garlic
describe: angry snarling wolf with red eyes on black and white background
